# Typed finding checks

The actual Runtime `finding` tool proposes two registered methods and one
unregistered suggestion. A custom-checklist seed runs through the ordinary
default role. Profile mappings route `verify` to role `second` and `replay` to
role `first`, with exact tool capability requirements and retained proposal and
accepted result inputs. Names do not determine a method or grant authority.

The process test holds admission after the first Round, pauses, deletes the
released producer Run and restarts the Server. After resume, both ordinary
consumers read the exact retained proposal and mapping context. Public consumer
artifact downloads are compared with exact Project-scoped retained bytes,
including binary result packages. No target, live model or proof/replay policy
is exercised.
